title: 火金蛄 Hué-kim-koo
mood: shy, warm, a first date in the dark
subject: a first date on an unlit mountain road in April, switching the torch off to wait for the fireflies
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien dream pop. Offset-style electric guitars through chorus, long shimmer reverb and reverse delay, with slow e-bow swells; a Solina-style string-machine pad holding long chords; bass sustaining long roots with an occasional high melodic note; soft roomy drums of rim clicks, brushes and a gentle tambourine. Everything sits in a soft reverb wash, wide and warm, with the vocal set slightly inside the mix rather than on top. Breathy, airy female head voice, double-tracked, stretching the Taigi vowels over long notes. 84 BPM, D major. Shy, warm, a first date in the dark. No trap beat, no EDM drop, no acoustic folk strumming, no piano ballad, no shoegaze distortion wall, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.
lyrics:
[Verse]
四月的山路 暗摸摸
你騎車載我 騎到路尾
車停佇溪仔邊 你講手電仔禁掉
目睭 慢慢仔就會看著

[Pre-Chorus]
一點 兩點 佇草仔頂浮起來
我毋敢喘氣 驚共伊吹走

[Chorus]
火金蛄 火金蛄
一爍一爍 佇你的肩胛頭踅
暗暗的山 我看無你的面
干焦聽著 你咧笑

[Verse]
有一隻 歇佇我的頭毛
你講莫振動 我就毋敢振動
你的手 暗暗仔 揣著我的手
講是驚我 踢著石頭

[Chorus]
火金蛄 火金蛄
一爍一爍 佇咱兩个中央踅
暗暗的山 我看無你的面
手內 燒燒

[Outro]
手電仔
莫開
